L142: v0.1.3: bound MCP discovery-tool payloads + dashboard visualizations
L143: MCP (found via an independent third-party install): - what_moved/get_events/search were unbounded → the payload overflowed the client's tool-result limit, forcing agents to guess filters. Now newest-first with a limit param (50/50/25), total/truncated fields, what_moved defaults to a 30-day window (echoed), and events are slimmed to outlet names (full URLs via get_provenance). Live feed payload ~45K → ~14K chars.
L144: Dashboard (hand-rolled inline SVG, no new dependency): - low–consensus–high range bars on ranged metrics - history sparklines on company pages (only with real movement) - new sector market-map page (market.html); _money gains a trillion tier 89 tests (6 new), ruff clean, both packages twine PASS. Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
